arms.pt_pretrain: same arm, encoder initialised from a Pt pIC50 model

design.transfer: state_dict entries matched by name and shape; readout and metal_proj re-initialised because the conditioning vector differs

caveats: Pt is a different metal and a different corpus; this is domain-shift pretraining, not self-supervised pretraining. The plan's tmQM arm (no bioactivity) is not run.
One seed. The two arms share folds and seed, but not initialisation, so the comparison is paired by data only.
